messages:
mira-peopleops: Quick check  new hire Sophia's spouse is on H4 and recently got an H4 EAD; Sophia asked if spouses EAD allows immediate dependent benefits enrollment and if we need any extra immigration files for our records.

nate-payroll: For payroll/tax we only need the dependent's SSN and name. Benefits side needs proof of eligibility (marriage cert + EAD copy) to enroll them as a dependent.

dan-immigration: Correct. For eligibility verification, we ask for: (1) copy of spouse's EAD (front/back), (2) marriage certificate, (3) passport page. If EAD was issued overseas, include translation + passport visa pages. We do not need underlying H4 approval notice unless there's a discrepancy.

sophia-newhire: Thanks  spouse's EAD card number ends with 1234 and SSA card arrived yesterday. Do you want scans or originals? I'm remote.

mira-peopleops: Scans uploaded to the secure HR portal are fine to start enrollment. We'll schedule an originals check during your first pay-period orientation or via secure video verification per policy. Upload by end of week to hit the 30-day benefits window.

nate-payroll: One gotcha: if spouse's SSN was issued under a different legal name, send marriage cert + SSA card so we can map for W-2/benefits. Also confirm whether spouse will be on payroll for contractor work (if so we need visa compatibility checks).

dan-immigration: Also flag: H4 EADs can be revoked if primary's status changes. We recommend keeping copies of the underlying H4 approval (I-797) in case insurer requests proof of continued dependent eligibility. We'll store a note in the immigration folder if you upload both.

sophia-newhire: Uploading EAD + marriage cert + SSA photo now. One more question  will dependent dental/vision start same day as medical?

mira-peopleops: Usually yes if enrolled within the 30-day window; benefits team will confirm effective dates after processing. If anything looks off we'll reach out.

hr-bot: Reminder set: "Verify Sophia dependent docs" in 48h.

nate-payroll: Thanks  once the SSA photo is in I'll link it to payroll and confirm benefit start dates. If any immigration docs look incomplete, @dan-immigration will follow up.

sophia-newhire: Appreciate it everyone  done uploading and pinged HR for a quick video check if needed.
